transcript.text: Core market = customers with region = 'North'. Now count orders placed by these customers.

args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory.bench.orders o JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.region = 'North'
